answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 31540 Country: AF Title: Sale of computer,TV,Load speaker and other equipment that similar to them and that have two kind usege Is it Hala or Haram to do buiness Question: Sale of computer,TV,Load speaker and other equipment that similar to them and that have two kind usege Is it Hala or Haram to do buiness of these equipment because some people use it in right way and other in wrong way pl guide is business of these equipment is allow or not in Isalam Jazakallah . Answer ID: 31540 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 700/L=255/tl=1432) TV is the instrument of amusement in the present era; hence, its sale and purchase is not lawful. However, the sale and purchase of computer and loudspeaker is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
